blurb: Barrel of Monks Brewing offers award-winning Belgian-inspired craft beer brewed on-site, fresh food from an on-site food truck, and a taproom with indoor and outdoor seating. They host weekly entertainment including comedy nights, trivia, jazz and blues performances, and seasonal celebrations. The brewery also offers private event space rental for various occasions with flexible packages and catering options.
